title: The Geometry of Quasi-Cycles: How Stoichiometric Covariance Alters Pre-Bifurcation Signatures
summary: Environmental enrichment can destabilize predator--prey coexistence through a Hopf bifurcation, yet real ecosystems are finite and intrinsically stochastic. We investigate how mechanistically derived demographic noise shapes near-Hopf dynamics in the Rosenzweig--MacArthur model by systematically comparing two diffusion closures that share identical deterministic drift but differ solely in predation-induced covariance structure.
